basic_details.job_title: HAL Visiting Doctors Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline

qualification.details: Only Indian Nationals need apply. | Minimum 1 (One) year post qualification experience.

salary_details.details: Conveyance Charges: Rs. 200/- per visit. The remuneration per visit shall be revised by 10% upon extension of engagement, and will also be revised as per the directives from Corporate Office from time to time.

selection_process: Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria will be shortlisted based on more relevant experience/marks and will be called for personal interview.
how_to_apply: Download or obtain the prescribed application format for the post.
Fill in the application form completely in A4 size paper.

Attach self-attested copies of certificates with reference to Age, Educational Qualification, and Experience indicating date of joining & date of relieving, along with two latest passport size photographs.
Attach copies of Mark Sheets, Latest valid registration certificate issued by Medical Council of India (MCI) / State Medical Council, and Experience/service Certificates.
Super-scribe the envelope containing the application with Advertisement No. HAL-HYD/2026/03 and Name of the Post applied for.
Send the completed application by Speed Post / Registered Post / Courier only to MANAGER (HR), HR Department, Avionics Division, Post-HAL, Hyderabad-500 042 so as to reach on or before 27.10.2026.
important_instructions: The engagement will be purely temporary for an initial period of 2 (Two) years and will not confer any right to claim regular employment. Applications received through Fax, E-mail, or in person will not be accepted. Incomplete application forms or applications not in the prescribed format will be rejected. Candidates shortlisted for interview are required to bring original certificates and documents in proof of age, educational qualification, and experience. The part-time engagement is liable to be terminated by giving one month’s notice in writing from either side. Selected candidates will be required to visit the Company Hospital on suitable days and as and when required in emergencies. HAL is not responsible for any postal delay.

content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals need apply. Minimum 1 (One) year post qualification experience.

rows.qualification_required: MBBS recognized by MCI (Medical Council of India) / State Medical Council

content_sections.heading: HAL Visiting Doctors Salary
content_sections.text: Conveyance Charges: Rs. 200/- per visit. The remuneration per visit shall be revised by 10% upon extension of engagement, and will also be revised as per the directives from Corporate Office from time to time.

content_sections.heading: HAL Visiting Doctors Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria will be shortlisted based on more relevant experience/marks and will be called for personal interview.

content_sections.heading: HAL Visiting Doctors Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement will be purely temporary for an initial period of 2 (Two) years and will not confer any right to claim regular employment. Applications received through Fax, E-mail, or in person will not be accepted. Incomplete application forms or applications not in the prescribed format will be rejected. Candidates shortlisted for interview are required to bring original certificates and documents in proof of age, educational qualification, and experience. The part-time engagement is liable to be terminated by giving one month’s notice in writing from either side. Selected candidates will be required to visit the Company Hospital on suitable days and as and when required in emergencies. HAL is not responsible for any postal delay.

faq.question: Q1. What is HAL Visiting Doctors Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification released by Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), Avionics Division, Hyderabad to engage 5 Visiting Doctors on a part-time basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for HAL Visiting Doctors?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies notified for Visiting Doctors on Part-time basis.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for HAL Visiting Doctors?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application is 27.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for HAL Visiting Doctors?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree recognized by the Medical Council of India (MCI) or State Medical Council, along with a minimum of 1 year of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for HAL Visiting Doctors?
faq.answer: Candidates must be below 63 years of age as on 27.10.2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for HAL Visiting Doctors?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for HAL Visiting Doctors?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must submit their duly filled-in applications in the prescribed format along with self-attested documents by Speed Post, Registered Post, or Courier to the MANAGER (HR), HR Department, Avionics Division, Post-HAL, Hyderabad-500 042.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for HAL Visiting Doctors?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on relevant experience or marks and called for a personal interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the remuneration for HAL Visiting Doctors?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 1,700/- to Rs. 1,900/- per visit, plus conveyance charges of Rs. 200/- per visit.

faq.question: Q10. Is the job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely temporary for an initial period of 2 (Two) years, with possible extensions based on performance and requirements.
